title: gatewatch: merged constitution change without explicit human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit 552fa30094112d8815f90ac84bf69d2d9a55e239 (2026-09-30), file docs/CONSTITUTION.md, lines 1-142 (entire file added). Article IX requires changes to the constitution to receive explicit human review and forbids them from riding an auto-merged PR. The merged history contains no explicit human-sign-off tracker evidence for this change; author/committer metadata alone is not such evidence. Audit finding.

title: gatewatch: merged audit trigger changes without explicit human sign-off
description: Evidence: commit f9a0f8064a055dc33fa8e818dd725e4172ad953e, file .warren/triggers.yaml, lines 1-47 (new audit trigger entries including gatewatch-patrol, ratchetwatch-patrol, and tastewatch-sample). Article IX requires changes to audit entries in .warren/triggers.yaml to receive explicit human review and forbids them from riding an auto-merged PR. The merged history contains no explicit human-sign-off tracker evidence; author/committer metadata alone is not such evidence. Audit finding.
